resources.string: An office cat in a suit. Heavy-lidded and unimpressed until you reach for the phone
A bunny in a moonlit meadow. Perks her ears and waves back
A shiba pup at sunset. Wags, tilts his head at your swipes and barks on a tap
A tabby keeps watch while a mouse nibbles cheese. Tap and the cat pounces
A tiny hover-bot over a neon grid. Waves back and naps on the floor
Glowing jellyfish in the deep sea. Wave and they swim up together
A ringed planet and a little rocket that loops around it when you wave
Color fields and a ring of light that swirl and ripple with your hand

Each wallpaper has a little character or scene that reacts to you. It notices you when you unlock or come back to the home screen, waves when you tap the screen, nods on a double tap and looks around as you swipe between home screens. Leave the phone alone for a while and it falls asleep.
